findingDetails.title: Prompt-pack and workflow YAML contradict each other on the state-log write mechanism (gateway projection does not exist)
findingDetails.evidence: Prompt pack: state log is a read-only projection the gateway refreshes; direct write fails the iteration. YAML state_write_protocol: gateway does NOT refresh the legacy state file, direct writes must stay. append-mode-event.cjs has no projection-refresh code. fanout-run.cjs:727-754 tolerates the resulting double-record failure
findingDetails.recommendation: Align the prompt pack to the live mechanism (direct write + gateway intent) or implement the projection contract the prompt pack describes
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep deep-review-state/state_log in append-mode-event.cjs: no hits; both auto+confirm YAMLs carry the no-projection text; runner duplicate-record comment read

findingDetails.title: YAML fan-out call sites drop --convergence-mode (and confirm drops threshold/stop-policy)
findingDetails.evidence: All three fanout-run.cjs call sites omit --convergence-mode; runner reads it only from args (fanout-run.cjs:2910); compiled contract documents the flag (compiled/deep-review.contract.md:265); runner comment fanout-run.cjs:191-205 describes the exact gap
findingDetails.recommendation: Forward --convergence-mode (and threshold/stop-policy in confirm) at all fan-out call sites
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep fanout-run.cjs across all four deep-* YAMLs verified no call site passes the flag

findingDetails.evidence: Banner and divider appear twice at file top in both deep-review YAMLs; deep-research YAMLs are single-banner
